title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Cherry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Cherry E-Liquid adds a rich, stone-fruit twist to the legendary Pinkman profile. This blend is anchored by the signature Pinkman foundation of sweet Red Berries, merging the familiar taste of Strawberry and Raspberry with those characteristic zesty Citrus undertones. To this established classic, Vampire Vape infuses the deep, bold taste of ripe Cherry. The Cherry provides a darker, sweeter depth that contrasts with the zesty tropical hints of the original mix. It creates a well-rounded and intense fruit profile that is satisfying without being overly sharp, offering a sophisticated alternative to the original recipe. This 10ml freebase e-liquid is available in a versatile range of nicotine strengths, including 0mg, 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg. Please note that Vampire Vape adjusts the VG/PG ratio depending on the nicotine strength selected: 3mg is mixed at 50VG/50PG, making it ideal for most starter kits and pod vape kits. 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg are mixed at 40VG/60PG, which provides a sharper throat hit and is best suited for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) starter kits and lower-powered devices.
